facts.fact: AIP, citing an ANSSI-CI communiqué, says the national PKI falls under Loi n°2013-546 of 30 July 2013 on electronic transactions, which it says gives electronic signatures legal value (article dated 2026-07-25; law dated 2013-07-30).
facts.system: Loi n°2013-546 du 30 juillet 2013 relative aux transactions électroniques

facts.fact: AIP, citing ANSSI-CI, says decrees of 2014 and 2016 under the 2013 electronic transactions law govern cryptology services, electronic signature and electronic archiving; it gives no day or decree numbers (dated here to 2014 and 2016).
facts.system: Décrets de 2014 et 2016 de la loi n°2013-546

systems.tiers: all certification authorities operating in Côte d'Ivoire; administration, businesses, citizens
